title: MS Powder Coating
summary: Industrial-grade powder coating for fabricated mild steel structures, enclosures, frames, panels, and machinery covers. Pretreated via full chemical immersion for superior corrosion resistance.
description: High-durability powder coating engineered for all categories of mild steel components fabricated for machine covers, control panels, automotive brackets, and architectural metalwork. Resists scratching, UV degradation, and weather wear.
features: Uniform dry film thickness of 60 to 100 microns.
Available in matte, glossy, satin, texture, and metallic shades.

title: Fusion Bonding (FBE)
summary: Specialized fusion-bonded coatings achieving 250 to 500+ microns thickness for components exposed to aggressive chemicals, moisture, valves, pumps, and underground pipeline fittings.
description: We specialize in Fusion Bonding, an advanced process where a heavy coating thickness of 250 to 500 microns or more is achieved. Creates an impenetrable shield against highly corrosive environments, soil moisture, and harsh industrial chemicals.
features: Exceptional dielectric strength and corrosion resistance.
Ideal for industrial valves, pumps, pipes, and marine hardware.
Superior adhesion withstands high operational pressures.

title: Aluminium Powder Coating
summary: Specialized powder application for Pressure Die Cast (PDC), Gravity Die Cast (GDC), and extruded architectural aluminium profiles with zero surface defects.
description: Specialized surface finishing formulated for all kinds of aluminium substrates, including Pressure Die Cast (PDC), Gravity Die Cast (GDC), and extruded structural profiles. Prevents oxidation and delivers smooth, blemish-free finishes.
features: Processed through a dedicated 4-tank chromating chemical bath.
Eliminates pinholes, blisters, and surface outgassing defects.
Full range of architectural RAL colors and metallic textures.

title: Pre-Treatment Process
summary: Internationally acclaimed 7-tank degreasing, derusting, phosphating & passivation process for MS, and 4-tank chromating process ensuring lifelong chemical bonding.
description: No powder coating lasts without meticulous surface preparation. We adhere strictly to the internationally acclaimed Seven-Tank Pretreatment Process for MS components and the Four-Tank Chromating Process for aluminium components.
features: Degreasing → Water Rinse → Derusting → Phosphating → Passivation.
Accommodates components up to 22ft in length in chemical immersion tanks.
Guarantees 500+ hours of salt spray resistance.
